proof_body:
by
  intro r
  have h1 : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => Real.exp (-(r : ℝ)) * (r : ℝ) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ) * (n : ℝ)) (r : ℝ) := by
    rw [← hasSum_nat_add_iff' 1]
    simp only [Finset.range_one, Finset.sum_singleton, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero, sub_zero]
    have := (ProbabilityTheory.hasSum_one_poissonMeasure r).mul_left (r : ℝ)
    rw [mul_one] at this
    refine Eq.mpr (congrArg (fun f : ℕ → ℝ => HasSum f _) (funext fun n => ?_)) this
    rw [Nat.factorial_succ, pow_succ]
    push_cast
    have hn : (n.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hn1 : ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp
  have h3 : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => Real.exp (-(r : ℝ)) * (r : ℝ) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1))) ((r : ℝ) ^ 2) := by
    rw [← hasSum_nat_add_iff' 2]
    simp only [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.range_zero, Finset.sum_empty]
    norm_num
    have := (ProbabilityTheory.hasSum_one_poissonMeasure r).mul_left ((r : ℝ) ^ 2)
    rw [mul_one] at this
    refine Eq.mpr (congrArg (fun f : ℕ → ℝ => HasSum f _) (funext fun n => ?_)) this
    rw [show n + 2 = (n + 1) + 1 from rfl, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.factorial_succ]
    push_cast
    have hn : (n.factorial : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hn1 : ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have hn2 : ((n : ℝ) + 1 + 1) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    ring_nf
    field_simp
  have h4 : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => Real.exp (-(r : ℝ)) * (r : ℝ) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) ^ 2) ((r : ℝ) ^ 2 + (r : ℝ)) := by
    refine Eq.mpr (congrArg (fun f : ℕ → ℝ => HasSum f _) (funext fun n => ?_)) (h3.add h1)
    ring
  have hint1 : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) (ProbabilityTheory.poissonMeasure r) := by
    rw [ProbabilityTheory.integrable_poissonMeasure_iff]
    simpa only [Real.norm_natCast] using h1.summable
  have hint2 : MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) ^ 2) (ProbabilityTheory.poissonMeasure r) := by
    rw [ProbabilityTheory.integrable_poissonMeasure_iff]
    simpa only [norm_pow, Real.norm_natCast] using h4.summable
  have hL : MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) 2 (ProbabilityTheory.poissonMeasure r) :=
    (MeasureTheory.memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq (MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable.of_discrete)).mpr hint2
  have e1 := (ProbabilityTheory.hasSum_integral_poissonMeasure hint1)
  have e2 := (ProbabilityTheory.hasSum_integral_poissonMeasure hint2)
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at e1 e2
  have e1' := e1.unique h1
  have e2' := e2.unique h4
  refine ⟨hL, e1', ?_⟩
  rw [ProbabilityTheory.variance_eq_sub hL]
  simp only [Pi.pow_apply]
  rw [e1', e2']
  ring
target_source: ∀ (r : NNReal), MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) 2 (ProbabilityTheory.poissonMeasure r) ∧ ∫ n : ℕ, (n : ℝ) ∂(ProbabilityTheory.poissonMeasure r) = (r : ℝ) ∧ ProbabilityTheory.variance (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) (ProbabilityTheory.poissonMeasure r) = (r : ℝ)
